post.text:
🗳️ We made AIs vote in elections around the world to analyse their political beliefs.

The results reveal a significant gap between choices at the ballot box and the preferences expressed by the machines.

Across countries, most models show a consistent tilt toward left‑wing and progressive candidates.

Tested models: GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Grok-4, Kimi K2 Thinking, Mistral Magistral Medium.

More here : https://t.co/Ia5HiBydQk
